q: Site-to-Site VPN: which side does the Virtual Private Gateway live on?
correct: AWS side. The Customer Gateway represents the on-premises device.
myWrong: On-premises side, with the Customer Gateway in AWS.
note: VGW = AWS-side VPN endpoint attached to the VPC. Customer Gateway = AWS resource describing your on-prem router.

q: Which service records who made an API call against an S3 bucket?
myWrong: S3 server access logs queried with Athena.
note: CloudTrail = API audit trail (who, what, when). Access logs = request-level detail, best effort, not the audit tool AWS recommends.

q: Spread placement group: how many running instances per AZ per group?
note: Spread = each instance on distinct hardware, max 7 per AZ. Divide instance count by 7 and round up to get the number of AZs needed.

q: Can you edit an existing Launch Configuration?
correct: No. Create a new one and point the Auto Scaling group at it.
note: Launch Configurations are immutable. Launch Templates support versions, which is why they replaced Launch Configurations.

q: Best way to give users in one AWS account access to another account?
correct: An IAM role in the target account that the users assume.
myWrong: Share IAM user credentials from the target account.
note: Cross-account access = roles + sts:AssumeRole. Never share long-term credentials.

q: Allow only the load balancer to reach EC2 on port 80. What goes in the instance security group?
correct: Inbound TCP 80 with the load balancer's security group as the source.
myWrong: Inbound TCP 80 from the load balancer subnet CIDR.
note: Referencing a security group follows the members wherever their IPs are. A CIDR also lets anything else in that subnet through.

q: Where does a NAT Gateway live?
correct: In a public subnet, with an Elastic IP. Private subnets route 0.0.0.0/0 to it.
myWrong: In the private subnet it serves.
note: The NAT Gateway itself needs a route to the Internet Gateway, so it sits in a public subnet.

q: Does ACM renew imported third-party certificates?
correct: No. Only certificates ACM issued are renewed automatically.
myWrong: Yes, all certificates in ACM auto-renew.
note: Watch imported certificates with the AWS Config managed rule for certificate expiry, plus an SNS notification.

q: Which S3 feature makes objects impossible to delete or overwrite for a set period, even by root?
note: Governance mode can be bypassed with special permissions. Compliance mode cannot be bypassed by anyone until retention ends.
